observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Dance studio with wood flooring and a colorful graffiti-style mural on the back wall
observation.dancers: One couple: one man and one woman
observation.formation_and_space: Partnered couple facing each other, dancing on the spot within a stationary framing
observation.posture: Torso upright with a slight forward inclination, knees softly bent and relaxed, weight shifting between feet
observation.footwork: Shifting weight from one foot to the other in place, alternating slow and quick weight changes; stepping back for rock steps on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: Open and closed positions; hands held in a soft frame or joined at chest level, varying between open hold and closed embrace
observation.hips_and_torso: Hips move naturally with weight shifts and hip-led weight changes; torso remains relatively upright and stable
observation.partnering: Paired dance with closed and open holds, lead-and-follow demonstrated by the male lead
observation.levels_jumps_turns: No jumps, floor work, or turns visible in the demonstration segments; kept at a low, grounded level
observation.costume_and_props: Man wears a grey short-sleeve button-down shirt and blue jeans; woman wears a blue patterned short-sleeve top and blue jeans
observation.cannot_infer: Precise foot mechanics and heel-toe articulation are partially obscured by camera angle and pant legs; full-body crowd context is limited to initial introductory clips.

signature_moments.what: Open and closed position transitions with weight shifts in place
